name: Cyclops
desc: A one-eyed giant that makes up for it's lack of depth perception by being very large.
weakness: Must be struck in the eye with any type of piercing weapon

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: The cyclops stomps the ground and all creatures within 5m are knocked back 5m and prone unless they make a succesful endurance save.

actions.name: Greatest Club
actions.desc: +8 smash down onto a creature within 5m range.
